column2: [intro]
In my kitchen, I have a blast,
Creating meatless dishes that I make fast.
Today, I’ll share my passion with glee,
Vegetarian lasagna, it’s the one for me.
Oh, I love to cook, lasagna's my pride,
A mix of colors and flavors, it’s a joyful ride.
With fresh veggies, I’m as happy as can be,
Vegetarian lasagna, my go-to recipe.
In my fridge, I keep all that I crave,
Zucchini, mushrooms, peppers, and more to save.
I slice them thin while singing away,
Layer them between pasta, passionately I play.
Oh, I love to cook, lasagna's my pride,
A recipe of love, my guests will be satisfied.
With a touch of Parmesan, it’s a grand delight,
Vegetarian lasagna, an overdose of taste so right.
